snippet.title: Super Mario Blue Twilight DX on G4's Attack of the Show (2005 VHS Recording)
snippet.description:
More info including a link on where to download the game is included further down in this description. 

This recording is over 8 years old now. With G4 and Attack of the Show being gone, this is probably the clearest version of this I'll ever have. I captured it off my own VHS tape, which is why it's so grainy and blurry. 

A word to the wise to anyone out there: If you feature somebody else's content, make sure you contact the person who made it if only so they can know it's happening and maybe record it. I had to hear from other people that they featured my game, and I recorded this from their second airing later that night. 

If anyone has a clearer version of this, I would like to have it.

You can download the game here: http://mfgg.net/index.php?act=resdb&param=02&c=2&id=1963
